prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes generally worked, winning 2 out of 3 tests with an average noise-corrected lift of +1.6%.
home, wait_info changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
home, new_flow changes consistently failed to show positive impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
Evidence remains mixed for finish, new_screen, choose_path, hint, and adoption, redesign, as results were inconsistent across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test completed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Adoption Certificate Overview: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet traits on one side and adoption confirmation details on the other. (why: The adoption step drops to 66.0% conversion with 89s median time. Structured two-column layout clarifies choices and speeds up final confirmation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Setup Checklist Screen: Add an interactive checklist on the final intro screen detailing how to summon, minimize, hide, and talk to your desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3 emails) about how to control, hide, or interact with pets after completing onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Quiz Flow: Introduce a interactive quick quiz flow on path selection to guide undecided users to the best pet creation option. (why: The choose_path step has an extremely high mean time (514s vs 8s median), showing that struggling users spend significant time stuck on path selection.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Saved Pet Account Protection Headline: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize that signing in prevents pet data loss and restores existing pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing back in. Sign-in copy changes consistently produce strong positive lift (+1.6% average).)
4: [choose_path, layout] Compact Path Options Layout: Switch path selection to a compact layout that simplifies decision-making and reduces visual clutter. (why: High mean duration on choose_path (514s) indicates option paralysis or cognitive load for a subset of users.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Interaction & Command Guide Copy: Rewrite home intro text to give explicit instructions on tray icons, right-click context menus, and chat keybindings. (why: Support theme after_onboarding confusion shows users are unaware of basic desktop pet interaction mechanisms.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Tray Sound Notification: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and audio sound prompts on the waiting screen when asset building completes. (why: The home wait step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report uncertainty over whether the desktop pet app opened.)
